packageRules.description: The *arr apps release constantly. One PR for the lot.
Immich migrations are one-way and it warns against skipping versions. Keep it on its own PR and let a release settle first.
Sure runs one-way Rails migrations and releases often. Its own PR, after a release has settled.
A Postgres major can't read the previous major's data directory. That upgrade is a dump and restore, not a tag bump.
